data-pool.name: J1939
data-pool.comment: Automatically generated Datapool for J1939 CAN communication

data-element.name: ControlPurpose
data-element.comment: State signal which indicates which control mode the sending device is using to generate the TSC1 command.

data-element.name: EngRqedSpeedCtrlConditions
data-element.comment: This mode tells the engine control system the governor characteristics that are desired during speed control.

data-element.name: EngRqedSpeed_SpeedLimit
data-element.comment: Parameter provided to the engine from external sources in the torque/speed control message.

data-element.name: EngRqedTorque_TorqueLimit
data-element.comment: Parameter provided to the engine or retarder in the torque/speed control message for controlling or limiting the output torque.

data-element.name: EngineRequestedTorqueHiRes
data-element.comment: This parameter displays an additional torque in percent of the reference engine torque.

data-element.name: MessageChecksum
data-element.comment: The checksum is used to verify the signal path from the transmitting device to the receiving device.

data-element.name: MessageCounter
data-element.comment: The message counter is used to detect situations where the transmitting ECU malfunction repeats the same frame all the time.

data-element.name: TransmissionRate
data-element.comment: This parameter indicates the transmission rate at which the sending device will transmit the TSC1 message.

data-element.name: AgvChassisAirFilterRestrictPrcn
data-element.comment: Original name (from import source): AgvChassisAirFilterRestrictPrcnt

data-element.name: ActlEngPrcntTrqueHighResolution
data-element.comment: This parameter displays an additional torque in percent of the reference engine torque.

data-element.name: ActualEngPercentTorque
data-element.comment: The calculated output torque of the engine.

data-element.name: DriversDemandEngPercentTorque
data-element.comment: The requested torque output of the engine by the driver.

data-element.name: EngDemandPercentTorque
data-element.comment: The requested torque output of the engine by all dynamic internal inputs, including smoke control, noise control and low

data-element.name: EngSpeed
data-element.comment: Actual engine speed which is calculated over a minimum crankshaft angle of 720 degrees divided by the number of cylinders.

data-element.name: EngStarterMode
data-element.comment: There are several phases in a starting action and different reasons why a start cannot take place.

data-element.name: EngTorqueMode
data-element.comment: State signal which indicates which engine torque mode is currently generating, limiting, or controlling the torque.

data-element.name: SrcAddrssOfCtrllngDvcFrEngCntrl
data-element.comment: The source address of the SAE J1939 device currently controlling the engine.
